name: Documented after-tax RMB income → bank conversion → SWIFT wire
verified_limit: No annual USD cap is stated for a non-domestic individual's conversion of lawful current-account income; the bank reviews authenticity. The USD 50,000 annual total in Art. 2 is expressly tied to domestic individuals' purchases and to all individuals' FX sales.
verified_cost: 0% PRC tax on the conversion itself (S04 Art. 2 lists no such category); the tax is on the underlying income.

name: Re-conversion of unused RMB from an earlier FX conversion (original exchange memo)
verified_limit: Bounded by the amount on the original memo and the 24-month validity window.
verified_cost: 0% tax: this is a return of your own previously converted principal, not new income.

name: Walk-in small-amount re-conversion with ID only
verified_limit: USD 500 per day; USD 1,000 per day at port outlets; per person.
verified_cost: 0% tax. Commercial spread/fee unverified.

name: Remit an existing FX savings-account balance abroad
verified_limit: Art. 15(1) states no annual amount for a non-domestic individual's outward remittance from an FX savings account. (Domestic individuals are handled under Art. 14: USD 50,000/day with ID, above that with authenticity documents.)
verified_cost: 0% PRC tax; 0% US tax on moving your own funds.

name: Overseas ATM cash withdrawals with a PRC bank card
verified_limit: RMB 100,000 equivalent per individual per civil year across all cards; RMB 10,000 equivalent per card per day. Exceeding the annual cap suspends overseas cash withdrawal for the current and the following year.
verified_cost: 0% tax. Commercial: issuer conversion rate, out-of-network ATM surcharges - unverified.

name: Overseas merchant / POS spending with a PRC card
verified_limit: No published fixed amount; spending must be genuine personal consumption and the card's own limit applies.
verified_cost: 0% tax. Not a way to obtain USD cash for other purposes.

name: Carry physical cash across the border
verified_limit: PRC declaration limits: not re-verified in this session (prior sessions cited the GACC passenger guide, S22). US side verified: more than USD 10,000 must be reported on FinCEN Form 105, aggregated across a family or group.
verified_cost: 0% tax if declared. Seizure risk if not declared (S14).

name: Sale of PRC real estate by a foreign individual, then remit after-tax proceeds
verified_limit: No fixed cap; documentation-driven. Real-estate FX handling is governed by the separate property rules referenced in S02 Art. 21.
verified_cost: PRC IIT on the transfer gain at 20% (S04 Art. 3(3)); 0% tax on the act of conversion.

name: Inheritance outbound transfer (继承财产转移)
verified_limit: Procedure-based; the amount follows the estate documents. The 2004 notice is cited from a prior session (S17) and not re-fetched here.
verified_cost: PRC IIT treatment of inherited assets depends on the asset and the estate's tax position; not quantified here.

name: Emigrant personal-asset transfer (移民财产转移) — former PRC residents only
verified_limit: Procedure-based, one-time in principle; tied to assets held before emigration and to the household-registration cancellation.
verified_cost: PRC taxes on the underlying assets as applicable; 0% on conversion.

name: PRC-citizen USD 50,000/year facilitated FX purchase quota
verified_limit: USD 50,000 equivalent per person per calendar year (S02 Art. 2; S01 Art. 9).
verified_cost: 0% tax on the purchase itself.

name: Transfer between FX savings accounts of immediate relatives
verified_limit: Domestic FX-account transfers only; a transfer between a domestic and a non-domestic individual's account is treated as a cross-border transaction (S02 Art. 28(3)).
verified_cost: 0% tax on the transfer; the receiving relative's own quota and tax position then apply.

name: PRC employer pays salary directly to your US account
verified_limit: No personal cap; the employer's remittance rules and the tax record filing apply.
verified_cost: PRC IIT withheld at source (3%-45% comprehensive, S04); 0% on the remittance.

name: Dividends / profit repatriation from a PRC company you own
verified_limit: No personal cap; corporate tax and withholding must be settled first.
verified_cost: PRC withholding on dividends at the 20% statutory flat rate (S04 Art. 3(3)); a treaty rate may reduce this but was not re-verified here (F04).

name: Equity transfer or company liquidation proceeds
verified_limit: No fixed cap; the taxable gain and approvals drive the timing.
verified_cost: PRC IIT on the transfer gain at 20% (S04 Art. 3(3)); 0% on conversion.

name: Genuine cross-border service fees, royalties or IP licensing
verified_limit: No cap; arm's-length pricing and genuine delivery are required.
verified_cost: PRC withholding on royalties at the 20% statutory flat rate (S04); VAT may also apply (not re-verified).

name: Individual FX settlement account / licensed payment institutions
verified_limit: Requires foreign-trade registration or a licensed institution; not a personal remittance channel.
verified_cost: 0% tax on conversion; business income tax applies to the underlying profit.

name: Splitting amounts across friends' or relatives' USD 50,000 quotas (smurfing)
verified_limit: Not lawful — no limit applies because the channel itself is prohibited.
verified_cost: Not a cost: a penalty. Up to 30% of the amount, or 30%-100% if serious, plus confiscation and possible criminal liability (S11 Arts. 39-45).

name: Underground banks and informal onshore/offshore RMB-USD swaps (对敲)
verified_limit: Not lawful — no limit applies because the channel itself is prohibited.
verified_cost: Not a cost: a penalty. Up to 30%, or 30%-100% if serious, plus confiscation (S11 Art. 45).

name: Crypto / stablecoin OTC bridge
verified_limit: Not lawful — no limit applies because the channel itself is prohibited.
verified_cost: Not a cost: a penalty. Virtual-currency business activity is prohibited; FX and criminal exposure also apply. Not re-fetched here.

name: Fabricated or over-invoiced trade / consulting contracts
verified_limit: Not lawful — no limit applies because the channel itself is prohibited.
verified_cost: Not a cost: a penalty. Illegal FX arbitrage: up to 30%, or 30%-100% if serious (S11 Art. 40).

name: Overseas POS cash-out, or borrowing other people's bank cards
verified_limit: Not lawful — no limit applies because the channel itself is prohibited.
verified_cost: Not a cost: a penalty. Card use is suspended and fines follow; borrowing or lending cards to evade the rules is expressly prohibited (S03).
